Method & provenance

SOURCE REVIEW / NO RUNTIME CONFORMANCE TESTS

Support decision rules

Supported
C definition, implementing macro, valid predefined callback, or exact API documentation. The inspector identifies the evidence.
Unsupported
Missing from the release sources, an aborting unimplemented body, or a success-only stub that produces no required output or state. Source contradictions override documentation.
Unknown
Conflicting source definitions whose exposed symbol cannot be resolved without a build/linkage check.

Header declarations and exported symbol names alone do not establish implementation. Valid null callbacks and permitted no-ops are supported.

Support is positive source evidence, not a guarantee of every backend, platform, argument combination or build configuration. MPI-I/O requires the I/O component; Open MPI’s removed MPI-1 declarations require --enable-mpi1-compatibility.

Catalogue boundaries

714 entries: the final MPI 5.0 PDF’s C binding summary, plus MPI_Aint_add / MPI_Aint_diff, MPI_Wtime / MPI_Wtick and ten removed legacy routines. Predefined callbacks and null conversion sentinels are included. The released MPI 5.0 vault independently confirms all 704 standard C entries; ten removed legacy routines are retained separately.

Other constants, callback typedefs, Fortran-specific procedures, MPIX extensions and duplicate PMPI profiling aliases are excluded.

Standard organization

Chapters and sections follow MPI 5.0. Blocking, nonblocking and persistent operation forms are separate from communication mode, scope and procedure blocking semantics. The inspector shows the complete section path and applicable attributes.

Introduction revision

Historical binding summaries and explicit change logs determine introduction. MPI-1 routines map to 1.0 using the archived 1.1 summaries. The revision describes the API name, not every later semantic change.

Final MPI 5.0 PDF ↗ · Standards archive ↗

Audit procedure & unresolved case

Official release archives are scanned for C implementations, declarations and binding generators. Tests and examples are excluded. Candidate stubs, macros and callback aliases are reviewed against the same release.

MPICH’s generated C locations refer to the release archive. Where available, evidence links point to the versioned generator template.

MPC MPI_Register_datarep: the core aborting stub conflicts with a bundled ROMIO implementation. Build/linkage resolution remains outstanding. Select that API to compare both sources.
